selectionReason: Public DESI DR2 likelihood data permit an immediate falsifiable test of whether one redshift block, smooth late expansion, or a changed early ruler is carrying the Hubble-scale conflict. The calculation can reject explanations even without proprietary data or physical equipment.
newVerifiedFacts: The local implementation reproduces the DESI DR2 flat-LambdaCDM headline with Omega_m=0.297462 and h*r_d=101.5398 Mpc.
The largest leave-one-redshift-block shift in h*r_d is 0.664 full-fit sigma at z=0.51; no one block dominates at the preregistered one-sigma threshold.
Flat wCDM reduces chi-square by 1.230 but worsens AICc by 2.237; flat w0waCDM reduces chi-square by 4.652 but worsens AICc by 3.148.
Combining DESI's identified product with the published Planck ruler gives the diagnostic H0=69.03+-0.51 km/s/Mpc, 4.019 sigma from the full SH0ES summary.
At the SH0ES central H0, DESI requires r_drag=138.72+-1.98 Mpc, 5.69 percent below the Planck base-LambdaCDM ruler and 4.194 propagated sigma away.
A dependency-free Node implementation agrees with the Python result to 6.7e-9 in Omega_m, 5.3e-7 Mpc in h*r_d, 4.3e-13 in chi-square, and 3.5e-7 in the principal tension diagnostic.

hypothesisAdjudication.claim: The public Gaussian likelihood reproduces the official DESI DR2 flat-LambdaCDM headline.
One released BAO redshift block alone controls the inferred scale.
Smooth late-time w or w0-wa freedom resolves the ruler/local conflict without an information-criterion penalty.
DESI BAO, the Planck standard ruler, and the full SH0ES value are compatible within three propagated standard deviations.
A physically viable early-universe model can shorten r_drag enough while satisfying BBN, full CMB spectra, structure growth, and independent distance data.

causalChain: Input: public 13-element DESI DR2 BAO Gaussian mean and covariance, flat FLRW, and predeclared model bounds.
Bottleneck: BAO determines h*r_d rather than H0 and r_d separately.
Bridge: an independent absolute ruler or absolute expansion measurement must break the multiplicative scale symmetry.
Adjudicand: posterior-level consistency of the inferred short ruler across independent CMB/BBN, BAO, supernova, and distance-ladder reductions.
Resolution: one predictive physical model passes those independent reductions and out-of-sample observables without calibration reuse or unbudgeted systematics.

workPackages.purpose: Replace marginal-Gaussian multiplication with released posterior samples.
workPackages.method: Reweight or jointly sample DESI DR2 chains with each released CMB-prior and supernova likelihood family, keeping source and date manifests frozen.
workPackages.deliverable: A posterior-level distribution of H0, r_drag, w0, and wa for each likelihood family.
workPackages.pass: The short-ruler direction survives all eligible likelihood families with stable effective sample size.
workPackages.fail: The direction changes sign, depends on one likelihood family, or importance weights collapse.
workPackages.next: If failed, isolate the exact likelihood term causing the change before enlarging the model.

workPackages.purpose: Separate local-ladder calibration from sample selection.
workPackages.method: Freeze anchors and supernova selection, then perform leave-one-anchor and leave-one-host-family audits across HST and JWST methods.
workPackages.deliverable: Influence functions for anchors, hosts, calibrator classes, and photometric systems.
workPackages.pass: No omitted rung moves H0 by one full posterior sigma and method offsets fit the declared covariance.
workPackages.fail: One rung dominates or residuals track an instrument or method boundary.
workPackages.next: If failed, treat the responsible calibration branch as the active bottleneck.

workPackages.purpose: Test whether a shorter early ruler is physically admissible.
workPackages.method: For preregistered early-energy or recombination perturbations, predict BBN abundances, full CMB TT/TE/EE+lensing, matter power, and DESI BAO before opening held likelihoods.
workPackages.deliverable: A model-by-observable falsification matrix with one independent pipeline per decisive observable.
workPackages.pass: One model reaches the required ruler interval and improves held joint predictive score without shifting another observable beyond its uncertainty budget.
workPackages.fail: The ruler remains too long, the CMB/BBN fit breaks, or extra freedom only improves development data.
workPackages.next: If all declared families fail, tighten the impossibility region rather than adding unconstrained parameters.

uncertaintyBudget: Measurement: DESI mean/covariance is consumed as released and does not expose raw clustering or reconstruction systematics.
Model: flat wCDM and CPL w0-wa cover only smooth late expansion and are not an exhaustive dark-energy class.
Statistical: AICc is used for this 13-point likelihood; posterior model probability and look-elsewhere effects are not inferred.
External calibration: Planck and ladder marginals are propagated as independent Gaussian summaries despite possible covariance and non-Gaussianity.
Extrapolation: converting a short ruler into early-universe physics requires full CMB, BBN, growth, and independent distance tests not performed here.
structuralConnection: CONN-EVIDENCE-034 maps the BAO h*r_d scale symmetry to gain-state non-identifiability in digital twins. The mathematical mapping is exact under a constant multiplicative calibration; physical transfer remains untested.
failedOrRejectedAttempts: Attributing the scale to one BAO redshift block failed the preregistered one-sigma influence threshold.
Adding constant-w or CPL freedom improved raw chi-square but failed the AICc rescue rule and demanded an even shorter ruler at the SH0ES central value.
The cycle did not obtain raw local-ladder or CMB likelihood access and therefore did not upgrade product diagnostics to a joint conclusion.
claimBoundary: This cycle constrains explanations; it does not solve the Hubble tension, establish dynamical dark energy, or prove early new physics.
exactNextStart: Load the official DESI DR2 chains and the three released supernova likelihood families. Freeze an eligible-chain manifest and compute posterior-level H0-r_drag bridges under at least two CMB calibration choices. In parallel, define a leave-one-anchor local-ladder audit. Continue only if the inferred ruler shift survives effective-sample-size, likelihood-family, and calibration-independence gates.
